address: via San Giovanni 1, località Vighizzolo, Montichiari, 25018, Italy
bio: Situated in a small village in the Bassa Bresciana region, this restaurant comes as something of a surprise due to its focus on fish, with the selection of raw seafood options and the good-value-for-money tasting menu particular highlights. Personalised cuisine which is full of flavour, served in modern, convivial dining rooms....
